name: envelope
expr: [up, lo] = envelope(sig); [upa, loa] = envelope(sig, 8, 'analytic'); [upr, lor] = envelope(sig, 5, 'rms'); [upp, lop] = envelope(sig, 1, 'peak'); upn = envelope(sig, 4);
comment: Sig: [yupper, ylower] = envelope(x[, n[, method]]). Four modes match MATLAB R2025b envelope.m exactly: default (no n) FFT |hilbert(x-mean)| with mean restored; 'analytic' n-tap Kaiser(8)-tapered Hilbert FIR; 'rms' sliding-window RMS; 'peak' spline (parabola for 3 knots, not-a-knot for 4+) through local maxima/minima with MinPeakDistance n. DC-removal applied for analytic/rms/default; not for peak.
